reason: No proposal has fresh eligible performance evidence. Prior one-step preload and two-step unroll candidates both failed promotion; the four-step variant also failed to establish a gain. The k_loop_schedule proposal is a one-step load/compute pipeline, but it overlaps the prior preload idea, so its expected benefit is uncertain. I ranked lower-risk changes first, then proposals that change loop scheduling or layout and carry greater correctness or timed-packing risk. tail_alignment is a safety change, not a throughput experiment.
